subject: Deal coverage calibration — Q3 reweight + stage tidy
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, J. Patel <j.patel@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: Wed, 21 Aug 2029 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Deal coverage calibration — Q3 reweight + stage tidy

Team / Aurora —

Quick note: finance pushed the Q3 coverage snapshot this morning and we’re sitting at ~0.62x coverage once we normalize for weighted commit. That’s below the target band for the quarter and we need tight stage hygiene + confidence pulls to avoid an emergency top-up.

Ask: please do the following by EOD today (Wed):
- Sales: update CRM stage to the closest accurate stage (Contracting / Legal / Verbal / Committed). No sticky "Negotiation" when paperwork is in legal — use Contracting - Legal.
- Enter a 1–5 confidence score on the deal record (1 = low, 5 = locked). Only mark 4–5 if legal has signoff calendar or PO confirmed.
- Attach any signed SOW/PO to the deal record and reply here if procurement needs any docs.

I’ve attached a working snapshot (pipeline_snapshot_Q3_v2.xlsx) with suggested stage adjustments and a conservative commit number in the second tab. Key calls out:
- RDW-3842 (Aurora) currently in Negotiation, ACV $240k — suggest move to Contracting - Legal and set commit to $180k (confidence 3) unless Aurora confirms PO this week.
- Several mid-market deals aged >60 days without activity — flagged in red in the sheet.

Ben/Karthik — can you own the sweep? I’ll roll up and send an updated coverage figure to Finance by 3pm PT tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pipeline_snapshot_Q3_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

Marissa —

Ran the sweep this morning. Short notes on RDW-3842 and the mid-market bucket:
- RDW-3842 (Aurora)
  - Previous ACV: $240,000; Recommended commit: $180,000 (confidence 3)
  - Reason: Legal review underway, procurement timeline ~7–10 days.
- Mid-market aging list: 18 deals flagged; aggregate ACV $1.1M, but realistic near-term commit ~45% of listed value.

Updated roll-up numbers:
- Net committed (post-sweep): $4.2M
- Upside (low-confidence): $1.0M
- Coverage vs quota (target $7.5M): 0.55x (improved slightly from 0.52x after stage clean)

Next steps:
1) I’ll attach a short PDF rollup and the cleaned export to the deal record.
2) Marissa, if Finance needs an intermediate figure for the leadership call, I can push a conservative snapshot to them before your 3pm PT deadline.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior AE, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — good, pragmatic cleanup.

I’ve uploaded the final rollup and the SOC2/data residency note to the Aurora deal record and sent the conservative coverage figure to Finance (they’ve acknowledged). Finance asked that we reconfirm any commits >= $150k with a one-line procurement confirmation email; Jay, if procurement can send that, we’ll mark RDW-3842 as confidence 4.

I’ll close this sweep and do a follow-up on Friday to see movement on the flagged mid-market deals. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Marissa
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
